tei:div.tei:p: "!# ༁ྃ: gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor las: o rgyan rin po che'i sgrub thabs dbang dang bcas pa bzhugs so: gu ru rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo:

pad+ma 'byung gnas sgrub pa ni: dang po rab ni 'di lta ste: dkyil 'khor thig bcas ma 'chug pa: dpe'u ris ltar bris nas ni: de steng gtor ma dpe 'u ris ltar: gtor ma de la'ang tsakli 'dzugs: de nas dmigs pa 'di ltar bya: rang nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar: rdo rje g.yas la bhan+dha g.yon: kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten par bskyed: sprul sku'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: de steng pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar: longs sku'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: yum sngon 'khyud de g.yas rdo rje: g.yon pas bhan+dha tshe bum 'dzin: de steng pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar: gcer bu stod g.yogs smad g.yogs can: mnyam gzhag bhan+dha nang rdo rje: zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: 'od ni dpag tshad du mar 'phro: shar du pad+ma 'byung gnas sngo: rdo rje g.yas la bhan+dha g.yon: kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten par bskyed: sprul sku'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: lho ru pad+ma 'byung gnas ser: rdo rje g.yas la bhan+dha g.yon: kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten par bskyed: sprul sku'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: nub tu pad+ma 'byung gnas dmar: rdo rje g.yas la bhan+dha g.yon: kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten par bskyed: sprul sku'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: byang du pad+ma 'byung gnas ljang: rdo rje g.yas la bhan+dha g.yon: kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten par bskyed: sprul sku'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: 'bring ni dkyil 'khor mi dgos shing: gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba bca': de nas dmigs pa 'di ltar bya: rang nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar: rdo rje g.yas la bhan+dha g.yon: kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten par bskyed: sprul sku'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: de steng pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar: longs sku'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: yum sngon 'khyud de g.yas rdo rje: g.yon pas bhan+dha tshe bum 'dzin: de steng pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar: gcer bu stod g.yogs smad g.yogs can: mnyam gzhag bhan+dha nang rdo rje:

zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: 'od ni dpag tshad du mar 'phro: bsdus pa dkyil 'khor gtor ma med: de nas dmigs pa 'di ltar bya: rang nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar: rdo rje g.yas la bhan+dha g.yon: kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten par bskyed: sprul sku'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: de yi ngang la sngags 'di bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: de yis pad+ma 'byung gnas 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya: kha tham: pad+ma 'byung gnas dbang bshad na: dang po bum pa thogs byas la: hūm̐: bum pa 'di ni rdo rje sems: khyod kyi mgo la blugs pa yis: sdig sgrib nyes ltung dag gyur cig: ma rig dbang rnams dag gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: badz+ra satwa hūm̐: de nas nas ni thogs byas la: 'di ni rin chen sna tshogs te: khyod kyis lha la phul ba yis: 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par shog: li yi maṇ+ḍal rin chen bsgyur byas nas: nas rnams kun kyang gser g.yur bsgyur nas kyang: bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku gcig la: dad pas 'bul lo thugs rjes bdag gzhan gzigs: dad pas slob mas thal mo sbyar byas la: rje bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: chos sku longs sku kun gyi ngo bo nyid: bdud kyi bar chad dbang du mi 'gro ba'i: sangs rgyas gdengs chen kun gyi ngo bo nyid: 'gro ba'i don la sprul pa'i skur bzhengs kyang: bdud dbang ma song 'ja' lus skur 'grub pa'i: gu ru rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: sogs/ byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: lho nub srin po'i grong khyer du: lha khang dgu brtsegs rim brtsegs steng: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar: rdo rje g.yas la bhan+dha g.yon: kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten par bskyed: sprul sku'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: de nyid ci ltar dung phyur dung: yungs kar phul gang gtor ba ltar: gnas nas thams cad rab tu byon:

thigs pa chu la brgyab pa ltar: lus dang dbyer med gcig par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: ā be sha ya a ā: dril bu 'khrol zhing lan bdun brjod: de nas bum pa thogs byas la: hūm̐: bum pa 'di ni gzhal yas khang: nang du pad 'byung lha tshogs bzhugs: khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis: lha tshogs thams cad thim par gyur: sku yi dbang rnams yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas pusti thogs byas la: hūm̐: pusti 'di ni rgyal ba'i gsung: rgyal ba'i gsung la lhag chad med: khyod kyi mgrin par bzhag pa yis: gsung gi dbang rnams yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs byas la: hūm̐: gtor ma 'di ni pad+ma 'byung: khyod kyi mgo la bzhag pa yis: thugs kyi dbang rnams yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas thig le ser po gtad la: hūm̐: 'di ni pad 'byung dkyil 'khor te: khyod kyi lte bar bzhag pa yis: yon tan dbang rnams yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas mtsho rgyal sku thogs la: hūm̐: 'di ni ye shes mtsho rgyal sku: khyod kyi gsang bar bzhag pa yis: phrin las dbang rnams yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: 'di nyid byang chub ma thob bar: yi dam bzung bar sems bskyed do: na ra kan: li yi maṇ+ḍal rin chen bsgyur byas nas: nas rnams kun kyang gser g.yur bsgyur nas kyang: bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku gcig la: dad pas 'bul lo thugs rjes bdag gzhan gzigs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha tham gu h+ya: zhes sprul sku rin po che mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gnyis me sprel gro bzhin can gyi tshes bzhi la o rgyan sprul sku'i cha lugs can gcig gis dngos su bka' bstsal pa lags so// maṅga laṃ//
